text:
tara: Drafting the release slate for tomorrow — includes adaptive routing feature flags, SDK snippet updates, and a brief migration note for Dedicated users. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
morgan: skimmed it. overall clean. two asks: (1) add a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers, (2) call out a known issue where streaming embed token counts can be off ~1–2 tokens for some legacy models
tara: added a migration checklist section and put a short note under Known Issues. updated the embed example to mention the token drift. PTAL
devon: small nit — python snippet still uses old import path (redwood.sdk.v0). should be `from redwood import Client` (v1 style)
tara: good catch, fixing now
samir: docs-ci: linkcheck found a 404 on /api/route-flags-example — looks like the redirect changed.
tara: fixed the path and pushed a new commit (force). also tweaked the language around fallback policies to be less prescriptive
morgan: also recommend we include a short rollout plan in the relnotes: canary 10% for 6h, 50% for 24h, full after successful monitoring. that helps SEs and customers plan
devon: add a one-line explainers section for "what to expect" (latency bump when prefix caching resets) — customers ask about perf changes
tara: added the one-liner about caching and latencies. included an example snippet for forcing prefix cache warmup: ```bash
# warm up prefix cache for a model
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b", "input":"<warmup prompt>"}'
```
samir: note: we should document behaviour when routing falls back to a quantized variant — quality might slightly differ. added to Known Issues
morgan: cool. also double-check the SDK samples in the JS section — one uses await client.generate where the method is now client.text.generate in new SDK.
tara: fixed JS snippet and re-ran snippet linter. docs-ci: snippet tests queued
docs-ci: snippet tests failed on one example — test harness timed out for the streaming example; retrying
docs-ci: snippet tests passed on retry. linkcheck OK. doclint OK
tara: thanks — merging in 10m unless anyone objects. target publish: 09:00 UTC tomorrow. anyone object? :thumbsup:
morgan: :thumbsup:
devon: +1
samir: +1
tara: merged. will schedule the publish and post the relnotes to #announcements when live. thanks all!
